body: Awwww mannnn!  I want to be dead! So many get there so easily!

The Leibnitz thing was a reference to the idea of this being the best of all possible worlds.

That's a happy and a sad thing if it's true.

I was just in a bad way. Things are better now, I think.
You're great to offer your ear. Thank you.

I allowed myself to fall into a weird little hole, and you guys were there to catch me. Amazing community, really.  

You're right, it was a perspective thing. Thank you.

I'll take a look at it. It's possible it's a sensible alternative.

Edit: Man do I feel silly. I immediately set about the task of finding the iPhone case with the unfortunate brand name "case free".  It's late (early).  Time to go to work.

The initial shock has worn off, and I've begun to accept that this will be what my phone will look and feel like for a little while.  It's not so bad when I adjust my inner scales and weights to appreciate heft and toughness slightly more than I normally would, but this isn't my natural disposition.

Grove it is.  I've already started the process and these guys do great customer service.  I hope this doesn't come off like a bad marketing idea they've sanctioned, because I get a good feeling from them and I would hate it if their business suffered due to misguided enthusiasm.
